contract.replay_reference: RecoveryJointGate with same rule/class/model and full executed history
contract.performance_gain_inference: paired t: normal-IID exact, otherwise asymptotic finite variance
contract.conditional_risk_inference: V39 stratum joint-harm/adoption bounds and strong-lag exact binomial
contract.failure: Incomplete horizon, abort, collision, route violation; no callback deadline cutoff
contract.timing: Measured callback latency, >500ms diagnostic only; no hard-real-time claim
contract.harm: Candidate failure OR baseline failure OR any cost/arrival regression >1e-9
contract.baseline_failure_handling: Retain capped cost, flag relative comparison unavailable; impute harm conservatively; reject deployment
contract.zero_adoption: Require same cost/arrival when both executions succeed; retain failures before first adoption
contract.selection: No rejected initial, sample replacement, model selection, threshold tuning or partial effect analysis
